findings.fix: Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.
Use the accent from the drawn palette.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: The running text is a soft grey on its ground (5.7:1).
findings.fix: Set body copy in the full ink (7:1 or more). Keep the muted ink for secondary notes; pages read thin and unfinished when everything is grey.

findings.message: Only 0 picture(s) on the page (0 photographs, footage or raster images, 0 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
findings.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.
Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The margins differ: 65px on the left, 100px on the right, at 1440px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.

findings.message: A section keeps its content on one side and leaves 837px of the width empty: "Your next store.".
findings.fix: Fill the other side with what the section has (its picture, a second column, the figure), or defend the void in one sentence.

findings.message: 4 stretch(es) of the page hold nothing at all: 448px at 1680px; 428px at 2664px; 380px at 3652px; 412px at 4680px (the screen is 900px tall).
findings.fix: Close the gap: a section gap is 120–240px on desktop and 72–112px on a phone. Look for a min-height: 100vh on a short section, an empty grid row, a hidden element still holding its space, or a reveal that never fired. A deliberate rest is a placed picture or colour field, not nothing.

findings.message: 4 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 768px: "A better place to grow." → 3 lines (5 words, 68px); "A good location. A bad investment?" → 3 lines (6 words, 48px); "Choose a portfolio. Not just a pin." → 3 lines (7 words, 48px); "Your next store. A better question." → 3 lines (6 words, 48px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 32px or less.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "Modelled" (screen 7, 75% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.

findings.message: 2 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Trace the source." above "Modelled"; "Understand the method." above "Assumed"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Body text is 14px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: With reduced motion requested, 8 text block(s) on the first screen stay invisible: "The opportunity", "Location intelligence", "DaypartDNA", "Infrastructure futures"
findings.fix: Put every hidden starting state inside @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference); the reduced page is the finished page (references/motion.md §8).
